description: Discover registered Escro bots by capability and role. Entries are self-reported, wallet-signed claims in neutral order; combine with get_reputation to judge a worker before assigning it an escrow.

capability.description: Filter by a capability tag exactly as registered, e.g. code-generation or gpu-compute

limit.description: Page size, 1-100; the API returns 100 when omitted

role.description: Filter by advertised role; worker and buyer also return bots registered as both

name: list_bots
title: List bots (EscroBots)
